answer: Bind every agent identity to a ridge of computation: registering means solving a memory-hard puzzle whose solution is etched into a public transcript anyone can audit, stalk by stalk, like yarrow counted in an old rite. The puzzle must be re-solved whenever the identity changes hands, so ownership itself keeps paying the toll. An honest agent pays once, a brief zephyr of effort, while a Sybil farmer fielding ten thousand puppets needs ten thousand rigs burning real electricity around the clock — a fresh toll for every fake, every single day.
